examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有一點兒累，我想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí.
examples.english: I am feeling a bit tired, I want to go home for a rest.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

items.wordHook: 有(have) + 一點兒(a little) → have a little: 有一點兒 means slightly.

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

items.wordHook: 有(have) + 意(meaning) + 思(think) → if it has meaning and thought, it's interesting.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

items.wordHook: a 亠(lid) rests on a 巾(cloth) stall where merchants gather → the busy 市(city).

examples.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

examples.chinese: 不少人喜歡買像史努比那樣可愛的娃娃。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén xǐhuān mǎi xiàng Shǐnǔbǐ nàyàng kě'ài de wáwa.
examples.english: Many people like to buy cute dolls like Snoopy.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
examples.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

examples.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。
鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 有位功夫明星的動作很快，一次能踢十幾腿，真的讓人驚訝。
當我們爬上那座高山，看見美麗的日出時，大家都驚訝地張大了嘴巴。

items.wordHook: Combining 驚(frighten) and 訝(amazed): 驚訝 means surprised.

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。
跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

items.wordHook: Combining 偏(slanting) and 僻(out-of-the-way): 偏僻 means remote.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。

items.wordHook: Combining 心(heart) and 意(thought): 心意 means kindly feelings.

examples.chinese: 這是我剛買回來的魚，吃起來又鮮又甜。
鮮奶是做冰淇淋、甜點不可少的東西。
這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這個用活魚做的菜又新鮮又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yòng huóyú zuò de cài yòu xīnxiān yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This dish made with live fish is both fresh and delicious.

examples.chinese: 這家超市的水果不但很新鮮，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shuǐguǒ búdàn hěn xīnxiān, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: The fruit at this supermarket is not only very fresh but also very cheap.

examples.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
媽媽買了鮮花來插花，她覺得插花是一門藝術，讓人欣賞到花的美。
那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
那個甜點的顏色像鮮血一樣，讓我嚇了一跳。
這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
這本小說的內容重複性太高，一點新鮮感都沒有。
保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
我很怕熱，不過天氣太冷的時候，也不得不開暖氣。
今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣暖和了，森林裡的草也綠了。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì nuǎnhuo le, sēnlín lǐ de cǎo yě lǜ le.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warm, and the grass in the forest has also turned green.

examples.chinese: 這條棉被是用品質很好的棉花做的，裡面的棉又白又溫暖。
我喜歡陪家人到公園的草地上野餐，氣氛溫暖又歡喜。
在冬天的深夜裡，坐在溫暖的地毯上靜靜地看書是一種享受。
我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

items.wordHook: Measuring the 距(distance) that lies 離(away from) two points: 距離 means distance.

examples.chinese: 緊張的時候試著慢慢呼吸，吸一口氣，再慢慢呼出來，可以讓你輕鬆一點兒。
要是你不能喝酒，跟客戶乾杯時可以用茶代替酒。
當你大學畢業，不再升學時，就得考慮就業問題了。
天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén bàogào shuō táifēng kuài lái le, chūmén shí děi zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The news report says a typhoon is coming soon; when going out, you must pay attention to safety.

examples.chinese: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 那位教授看報告看得很仔細，你可不能亂寫。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu kàn bàogào kàn de hěn zǐxì, nǐ kě bù néng luàn xiě.
examples.english: That professor reads reports very carefully; you must not write carelessly.

examples.chinese: 等我完成期末報告，就要跟同學去韓國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ wánchéng qīmò bàogào, jiù yào gēn tóngxué qù Hánguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: After I finish my final report, I will go traveling to Korea with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 老師的要求很多，要寫五篇報告、三篇作文，怎麼寫得完？
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yāoqiú hěn duō, yào xiě wǔ piān bàogào, sān piān zuòwén, zěnme xiě de wán?
examples.english: The teacher's requirements are many: write five reports and three essays—how can one finish writing them?

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.chinese: 上中文課時，老師要我們用中文報告在台灣的生活。
examples.pinyin: Shàng Zhōngwén kè shí, lǎoshī yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó.
examples.english: In Chinese class, the teacher wants us to report in Chinese on our life in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我得在家做一份報告，不能出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ děi zài jiā zuò yī fèn bàogào, bù néng chūqù wán.
examples.english: This weekend I have to stay home and write a report; I can't go out and have fun.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
學校書法比賽的獎品是一臺平板電腦，希望能鼓勵大家參加。

items.wordHook: 冬(winter) + 天(day) → winter days, so 冬天 means winter.
a 口(mouth) joins a 丩(vine) to shout a name → 叫(be called).
台北(Taipei) + 101 → the 101-story tower in Taipei: 台北101.
十(ten) books rest on 一(one) desk → the humble 士(scholar).
Under a 宀(roof) a 舄(shoe) stamps wet ink onto paper → 寫(write).
a 忄(heart) takes a 夬(decisive) leap → quick as a blink: 快(quick).
Combining 戰(war) and 爭(dispute): 戰爭 means war.
A barrier that acts to 障(separate) paths and 礙(block) forward movement: 障礙 means obstacle.
Combining 驕(haughty) and 傲(proud): 驕傲 means arrogant.
